data.text: Luke, I’m choosing 10, not 15. I learned to fish here with my family, and I want this lake to keep supporting our village. Taking an extra $5,000 now isn’t worth cutting next month’s stock in half. If we each take 10, we can earn $10,000 every month while letting the lake replenish. Let’s agree to that limit and review everyone’s catches together each month. John, Kate, Jack—will you commit to 10, and Luke, will you reconsider?
